- .github/workflows/validate.yml:232-234 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The login shape regex `^[A-Za-z0-9](?:-?[A-Za-z0-9])*(\[bot\])?$` combined with `(sub("\[bot\]$"; "") | length <= 39)` allows a 39-character body plus the `[bot]` suffix (44 characters total). GitHub's actual rule caps a login at 39 characters *including* the `[bot]` suffix, so the regex over-admits shapes GitHub would not issue.
  WHY: The risk is purely defence-in-depth: the next check `(.user.login == $author)` enforces exact equality against an API-reported author, so a 44-character login cannot actually reach this branch.
  Suggested minimal fix: Replace `(sub("\[bot\]$"; "") | length <= 39)` with `length <= 39`, and tighten the regex's inner repetition to bound the *total* length. Estimated lines changed: 2.
